title: Identify European Soil Evidence LZ streams
changes: Record source contracts for three complete Soil Evidence LZ77 streams; runtime ownership and other sampled bytes remain open.
validation: Protected unit frkft5lf authenticates the retained E260 audit and exact EUR ROM, decodes 1335 entirely sampled encoded bytes to 1640 bytes, and verifies hashes and absence of E231 owner overlaps.
limitations: The offline plan does not establish asset identity, original HLE call sites, other consumers or scenes and publishes no owner. Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified; no replay or performance comparison was performed.
